package.description: Run console apps and batch files without visible windows and handle UAC elevation.

en-US.description: Run console apps and batch files without visible windows and handle UAC elevation.
en-US.longDescription: Hidden Start is a lightweight command-line utility that runs console applications and batch files in the background without visible windows. It can handle UAC privilege elevation and start multiple commands in a specified order.
en-US.name: Hidden Start
